Class SpatialPhaseTransitionChronicleObserver

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.events.SpatialPhaseTransitionChronicleObserver
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class SpatialPhaseTransitionChronicleObserver extends Object implements Serializable

SpatialPhaseTransitionChronicleObserver

Evaluates spatial and macrosociological phase transitions across the active simulation domain to enrich generative historical chronicles. Detects emergent urban concentrations, acute demographic collapses, local golden ages of material capital accumulation, and systemic institutional bifurcations.

Calibrated against peer-reviewed cliodynamic models (Zipf's urban rank-size law, Bairoch 1988 historical urbanization thresholds, Peter Turchin 2016 Structural-Demographic Theory PSI indices, and Garrett 2011 thermodynamic capital-exergy coupling).

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
